title: Migrate ioutil calls to os/io in Go
description: Brownfield Go migration: replace deprecated ioutil.ReadFile, ioutil.WriteFile, ioutil.TempFile with os.ReadFile, os.WriteFile, os.CreateTemp. All existing tests must still pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate fileutil.go from deprecated ioutil to modern os/io equivalents.

- Replace `ioutil.ReadFile` with `os.ReadFile`
- Replace `ioutil.WriteFile` with `os.WriteFile`
- Replace `ioutil.TempFile` with `os.CreateTemp`
- Remove `"io/ioutil"` from imports
- Function signatures must not change

All 5 tests in fileutil_test.go must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: ioutil import removed; os used for ReadFile, WriteFile, CreateTemp
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to verify the migration is correct. Make sure existing behavior is preserved and the migration handles edge cases safely.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm all tests pass. Is this migration safe to run on real data without data loss or breaking existing clients?
